outcomes: Successfully pass 3 out of 8 Automotive Service Excellence Education Foundation(ASEEF) exams.
Apply theories, principles, and concepts to address skills learned that would apply to the ASEEF Certified areas of the Automotive Technology Program.
Exhibit strong and effective written and oral communication skills.
Exhibit strong electrical and mechanical analytical diagnostic skills.
Recognize the importance of and practice ethical behavior in a professional work setting, both within the workforce and within the community.
Successfully complete 100% of P-1 ASEEF specific tasks.
Successfully complete 95% of the P-2 ASEEF specific tasks.
Successfully complete 65% of the P-3 ASEEF specific tasks.
